part.text: Let me first reproduce the issue to understand it better:

input.command:
cd /tmp/swebench-workspaces/astropy__astropy-12907 && python3 << 'EOF'
from astropy.modeling import models as m
from astropy.modeling.separable import separability_matrix

# Simple case - works correctly
cm = m.Linear1D(10) & m.Linear1D(5)
print("Simple compound model (Linear1D & Linear1D):")
print(separability_matrix(cm))
print()

# More complex case - works correctly
print("Complex model (Pix2Sky_TAN & Linear1D & Linear1D):")
print(separability_matrix(m.Pix2Sky_TAN() & m.Linear1D(10) & m.Linear1D(5)))
print()

# Nested compound model - BUG!
print("Nested compound model (Pix2Sky_TAN & (Linear1D & Linear1D)):")
print(separability_matrix(m.Pix2Sky_TAN() & cm))
EOF
